statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and presyncope
There is concern for an underlying paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential rhythm disturbances during extended ambulatory assessment
The associated diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R55
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
Extended monitoring is medically necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias that intermittent symptoms suggest but that cannot be captured by shorter monitoring or in-office evaluation
